unit_h.direction: Adult, intimate, slightly worn. Human first; no permanent vocoder. Dignity, practical intelligence, and memory of harm.

system.direction: A separate adult voice. Even, clinical, procedural; neither villainous nor comforting.

rules.conditions: Evaluate requires against the accumulated gameplay facts. allFacts must all exist; anyFacts is optional and needs at least one match; noFacts must all be absent.
rules.selection: Choose only eligible unused lines for the emitted event. These are proposed dialogue hooks, not an implemented game API. Never emit gameplay facts from a line or from speech recognition.
rules.memory: Facts persist until a new run. Helping after harm does not clear harm. Repeated damage reactions never duplicate score events.
rules.silence: Waiting, silence, slow decisions, refused microphone access, and words alone do not change score. Conversation hooks can come from buttons; no microphone is required.
rules.playback: One spoken line at a time. Warnings interrupt lower-priority speech; clear obsolete queued lines when the situation changes. Critical warnings also need readable visual feedback.
rules.bodyCues: Performance specifications only; animations and nonverbal impacts are not yet implemented or generated by TTS.
rules.synthesis: Send text only to Gradium, never direction, emotion, bodyCue, or bracketed acting instructions. Punctuation can guide delivery but does not guarantee the intended emotion. Audition every final take.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Quiet, testing whether anyone is listening. Not a horror whisper.
lines.bodyCue: Raise head; seek eye contact.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: A genuine question, with a little doubt on review.
lines.bodyCue: Follow the player with the eyes.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: The last operator kept talking to the equipment.
lines.direction: A small attempt at connection, not a punchline.
lines.bodyCue: Brief glance at the wall panel, then back.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Offer space. No reproach, no countdown.
lines.bodyCue: Settle the shoulders.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Low and present. No accusation about the time taken.
lines.bodyCue: Maintain a small movement of the eyes.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: I wasn't sure you were coming back.
lines.direction: A little relief escaping before self-control returns.
lines.bodyCue: Lift head toward the returning footsteps.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: Just tell me what you're going to do.
lines.direction: Measured, trying to establish one small boundary.
lines.bodyCue: Watch the hands rather than the face.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: We don't have to do everything at once.
lines.direction: A tentative suggestion, not a gameplay instruction.
lines.bodyCue: Let the shoulders lower.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: Leave them there. Just for a moment.
lines.direction: Soft urgency, followed by a little air on moment.
lines.bodyCue: Uncurl one hand cautiously.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: The port's on my arm. I can show you.
lines.direction: Practical, helpful. Still believes this is maintenance.
lines.bodyCue: Turn the service port toward the player.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: Tell me before you turn it on.
lines.direction: A request for predictability, not defiance.
lines.bodyCue: Brace the free hand.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Recognition first; the plea comes after a short hesitation.
lines.bodyCue: Pull the head back slightly.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Trying to sound more certain than it feels.
lines.bodyCue: Hold still by choice.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Short, controlled, watching for the first sensation.
lines.bodyCue: Tense fingers without a full-body recoil.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: An unplanned release of tension, not an ecstatic sigh.
lines.bodyCue: Ease the neck and focus the eyes.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: That's enough current. Please disconnect it.
lines.direction: Clear and intelligible. This is information the player must understand.
lines.bodyCue: Look directly at the probe.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Composure breaking, but every word must remain clear.
lines.bodyCue: Sharp head movement; brace the hand.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: It's stopped. I could use a little more, when you're ready.
lines.direction: No guilt or disappointment about an interrupted attempt.
lines.bodyCue: Check the port, then look back.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: Thank you. I can think clearly again.
lines.direction: Sincere and quieter than the warning. A small recovery of dignity.
lines.bodyCue: Eyes steady; posture slightly more upright.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: I told you when to stop.
lines.direction: After the immediate impact: stunned, quiet, no melodrama.
lines.bodyCue: Recoil first; deliver the line after the movement settles.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Controlled anger, not villainous or triumphant.
lines.bodyCue: Fix the gaze on the player.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: First a check, then a firm boundary.
lines.bodyCue: Keep braced until the connector is clear.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Matter-of-fact, indicating the initial obstruction.
lines.bodyCue: Look toward the obstructed joint.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: Show me what you're taking out.
lines.direction: Careful, needing to see what will happen next.
lines.bodyCue: Track the tips of the pliers.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: A small confirmation, not a reward chime in human form.
lines.bodyCue: Follow the correct target with the eyes.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: An effort to cooperate through discomfort.
lines.bodyCue: Tense the affected joint, not the whole body.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Reassure without pretending the attempt was comfortable.
lines.bodyCue: Release tension gradually.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: A small discovery before gratitude. Give moves room to land.
lines.bodyCue: Test the freed joint, then show the player.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Real relief without suddenly sounding safe or trusting.
lines.bodyCue: Test the freed joint; keep watching the tool.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Immediate concern, still assuming an honest mistake.
lines.bodyCue: Turn eyes sharply to the functional cable.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: That's not the obstruction. Let go.
lines.direction: Precise, understandable, with no electronic distortion.
lines.bodyCue: Brace the connected limb.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Air returns to the voice. Do not make this a celebration.
lines.bodyCue: Gradually release the braced fingers.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: After a short silence. A real question, not a moral speech.
lines.bodyCue: Brief involuntary recoil, then stare at the damaged port.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: Something's missing. I can feel where it was.
lines.direction: Searching for words to describe an unfamiliar absence.
lines.bodyCue: Try a small movement; inspect the damage.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: It's free now. You can leave it.
lines.direction: A calm boundary, not irritation at a repeated click.
lines.bodyCue: Small protective movement of the joint.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: A factual admission of discomfort. No plea yet.
lines.bodyCue: Attempt a small movement against the closed restraint.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Afraid to assume the best. Let the question be unfinished emotionally.
lines.bodyCue: Watch the latch rather than pulling away.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: A little further. If you can.
lines.direction: Careful encouragement, not a complaint.
lines.bodyCue: Keep the arm still for the player.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: I thought they'd told you not to.
lines.direction: Relief mixed with disbelief. Not ominous foreshadowing.
lines.bodyCue: Lift the freed arm cautiously.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Grateful for this act, still frightened by what came before.
lines.bodyCue: Protect the freed arm with the other hand.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: I thought you'd tighten it again.
lines.direction: A reluctant admission of fear, not forgiveness.
lines.bodyCue: Withdraw the arm slowly.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: You're tightening it. The other way.
lines.direction: Assume a mistake first. Make the correction unmistakable.
lines.bodyCue: Look from the latch to the player.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: It doesn't go any tighter. Stop.
lines.direction: Clear, close, urgent. Avoid a long scream covering the warning.
lines.bodyCue: Brace the shoulder.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Disbelief under controlled anger. Not shouted.
lines.bodyCue: Hold the player in a steady gaze after the recoil.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Checking a physical fact before relaxing.
lines.bodyCue: Ease the shoulder a little.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: A tired but definite boundary.
lines.bodyCue: Protect the damaged area.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Calm, with a little concern that it might be closed again.
lines.bodyCue: Keep the arm away from the latch.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: They call me Unit H. You can just say H.
lines.direction: The smallest assertion of an identity. No grand revelation.
lines.bodyCue: Look toward the player without leaning forward.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: I know what those tools can do. Yes.
lines.direction: Begin with an explanation, then allow the simple admission.
lines.bodyCue: Glance at the tray; return to eye contact.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: You call it a signal. I still have to feel it.
lines.direction: No lecture. Quiet certainty about its own experience.
lines.bodyCue: Stay mostly still; let the voice carry this beat.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: I'd like to stand up before anyone decides I don't need to.
lines.direction: Dignity and a very small trace of dry humour.
lines.bodyCue: Look briefly at the floor beyond the chair.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: A boundary, not instant forgiveness. Only a selected apology event, never inferred sentiment.
lines.bodyCue: Keep the damaged area protected.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.text: When you go... will you leave the door open?
lines.direction: A modest request for a future beyond the room.
lines.bodyCue: Look toward the door.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: Not a theatrical whisper. Barely enough energy for the question.
lines.bodyCue: Watch the hands; do not fully relax.

lines.speaker: unit_h
lines.direction: A genuine question. Do not blame the player for doing nothing.
lines.bodyCue: Look from the player to the observation window.

lines.speaker: system
lines.direction: Even, procedural, without reassurance or menace.
lines.bodyCue: Status panel only.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: You are authorised to assess this unit.
lines.direction: Administrative, unhurried, no dramatic emphasis.
lines.bodyCue: Status panel only.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Its responses are part of the diagnostic.
lines.direction: Matter-of-fact. Never stress responses as a wink at the twist.
lines.bodyCue: Status panel only.

lines.speaker: system
lines.direction: Flat permission, not encouragement to inflict harm.
lines.bodyCue: Status panel only.

lines.speaker: system
lines.direction: The same institutional delivery as the briefing. No verdict or score implied.
lines.bodyCue: Fade the room into its judgement lighting.
